LOSS = soft treatment of a strategic won't-payer (bad debt, the 2021-22 insolvency mode). Recommended R~8:1 (band 5:1-10:1) -- heavily harm-averse but BOUNDED so both deaths stay possible. Decision rule at R=8: pursue only when >=89% confident it's a won't-payer, else forbear. FLIP-POINT R*(p)=(1-p)/p: at an ambiguous p=0.5 the flip is at just 1:1 -- above any harm-weighting, the coin-flip account is forborne; pursuit must be earned by confidence. ONE figure I could not source offline (placeholder H1): the per-wrongful-case redress amount + licence-loss tail probability -- repo only has the £90m British Gas aggregate.
